name: Song of Songs
author: Attributed in the title to Solomon.
date: Traditionally dated to the 900s BC. Date of final form is debated.
setting: A woman and a man exchange love poems.
theme: God made love and marriage good, and the church has long seen in it a picture of Christ and his people.
christInBook: The church has long read this book as a picture of the love between Christ and his people, though it is first of all a celebration of human love in marriage. The New Testament calls the church the bride of Christ (Ephesians 5:31-32).
howToRead: Read the book as a collection of lyrical scenes between a woman, a man, and a chorus of friends. Do not hurry. It is poetry about desire, and it teaches a right understanding of love, in the sense of “do not awaken love until it pleases” (2:7).
